dct_description_sm: These files contain data and R code associated with the paper “Habitat use and local movement of staging Lesser Yellowlegs (Tringa flavipes) differ between coastal and inland habitat in Atlantic Canada”, currently accepted to the Journal of Field Ornithology. In this paper, we combined behavioural observations, automated radiotelemetry tracking, and diet analysis to assess behaviour and habitat use, local movement and length of stay, diet, and abundance in relation to tidal level of Lesser Yellowlegs staging in coastal and inland habitats in the Canadian Maritimes.
dct_title_s: Habitat use and local movement of staging Lesser Yellowlegs (Tringa flavipes) differ between coastal and inland habitat in Atlantic Canada
